test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: R is taller than T. Both P and Q are taller than S, whose height is between P and T. If S is taller than T, who is the shortest?
solution:
1. R is taller than T

R > T

2. Both P and Q are taller than S

P > S and Q > S

3. S height is between P and T. S is taller than T

P > S > T

On combining these three statements we have 

 
• R > T
 
• P > S > T
 
• Q > S > T

In each of these cases, T is the shortest.

Hence, ‘T’ is the correct answer.
